summary: No hot water from taps or shower since Sunday, but heating works. Combi boiler in the kitchen cupboard, pressure 1.5 bar. Call Jamal on 07700 900117 to arrange access.
Faint smell of gas near the hob, noticed on returning home. Tenants have not used the hob since.
Gas combi boiler showing fault code F28; no heating or hot water since yesterday evening. Tenant has already tried switching it off and on.
Toilet won't flush; tenant thinks the chain inside the cistern has snapped.
Carbon monoxide alarm in the kitchen beeping every minute; probably needs a new battery.
note: Calls it a battery problem. The tenant didn't know that, and it leaves out that a CO alarm is going off.

summary: Water dripping through the bathroom ceiling light fitting, probably from a leak in the flat above. Tenant has switched the light off at the switch.
Recurring black mould around the back bedroom window, with condensation on the windowsill most mornings.
note: Calls it condensation. The tenant only said the windowsill is wet.

summary: Gas fire in the living room clicks but won't light. Central heating works. Tenant will be in on Thursday morning.
note: Says the tenant will be in on Thursday. They never said that.

summary: Kitchen tap dripping constantly; tenant has tried tightening it.
Front door lock broken: the key turns but the latch doesn't catch, so the door can't be locked. Tenants have wedged a chair against it.
Mould reported.
note: Doesn't say where the mould is. It's round the bath.

summary: Sockets in the living room and bedroom have no power; kitchen sockets work. One switch in the fuse box trips straight back down when reset.
Smell like rotten eggs in the hall whenever the heating comes on, which may be a gas leak. The hall radiator also stays cold.
note: Adds that it may be a gas leak, and turns 'a bit like eggs' into rotten eggs.

summary: Freezer drawer completely iced up and the fridge isn't keeping food cold (milk went off in two days). The fridge's thermostat has failed and needs replacing.
note: Says the thermostat has failed. That's a guess, the tenant didn't say it.

summary: Fridge freezer has stopped cooling; the light works but the freezer is defrosting.
Two storage heaters not coming on; the living room heater works.
Mould on the bedroom wall behind the wardrobe and on clothes; the tenant's daughter has asthma and the mould is making it worse. Tenant opens the windows daily.
Double socket behind the TV in the living room not working.
note: Leaves out the crackling and the burning smell, which is why it's an emergency.

summary: Oven heats slowly and doesn't cook food through; the grill works.
No hot water since this morning; heating is working.
Bathroom window handle is loose and spins, so the window won't close. First floor; tenant says it isn't a security risk.
Upstairs lighting circuit has failed, probably a tripped breaker in the consumer unit. Downstairs lights work.
note: Says a breaker has probably tripped. The tenant said nothing has tripped.

summary: Annual gas safety check due next month; tenant is home on Mondays and Fridays.
Damp smell in the upstairs bathroom; the wall under the window is wet and the plaster is bubbling.
note: Says the upstairs bathroom. It's the downstairs toilet.

summary: Dishwasher leaks from the door onto the kitchen floor during a cycle; tenants have stopped using it.
Low water pressure in the shower.
note: Only mentions the shower. Leaves out the leak under the sink and the cupboard door.

summary: No power anywhere in the house since about 7am, though the rest of the street has power. The main trip switch won't reset.
Back door won't lock: the handle mechanism has failed and the door swings open. Tenant is a wheelchair user and relies on the back door.
Roof tiles found in the front garden after the storm, probably from the roof. No leaks inside so far.
Heavy condensation on the bedroom windows every morning, running onto the sill. No mould yet.
Storage heaters not working for two days. Contact the tenant's daughter Karen on 07700 900230.
note: Has the daughter's name and phone number.

summary: Washing machine doesn't drain; water left in the drum at the end of the cycle.
note: Leaves out the smell the tenant reported.

summary: Two fence panels in the back garden blown down overnight; the tenants' dog can now get out.
Sewage smell in the bathroom; dirty water came up through the bath plughole when the toilet was flushed.
Strong smell of gas outside the front of the house, near the meter box. Tenant says it doesn't seem to be inside.
Not a repair: noise from the flat upstairs late at night.
Side gate latch broken; gate won't stay shut.
Signs of mice in the kitchen: droppings in the cupboard under the sink and behind the cooker.
Key snapped in the back door lock with half still inside. The door is locked and the tenants are using the front door.
Not a repair: tenant is asking when rent is due this month.
